events.name: Bash
events.head: Fetch origin and check commit placement and publish hold
events.input: $ git fetch origin -q; git branch --contains 9af89f1a -a 2>&1 | head; git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...main; grep -in "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm commit on origin and gather log evidence
events.input: $ git log origin/main --oneline -1; git merge-base --is-ancestor 9af89f1a origin/main && echo ANCESTOR; git log origin/main --oneline --ancestry-path 9af89f1a..origin/main | tail -1; grep -c "MongoDB written" ~/Library/Logs/tantra-tracker.log; grep "MongoDB" ~/Library/Logs/tantra-tracker.log | tail -2; grep -iE "relaunch|kill" ~/Library/Logs/tantra-docker-keepalive.log | wc -l; grep -iE "relaunch|kill|down" ~/Library/Logs/tantra-docker-keepalive.log | tail -12; tail -1 ~/Library/Logs/tantra-docker-keepalive.log; docker inspect tantra-mongo --format '{{.State.Status}} {{.HostConfig.RestartPolic

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show keepalive non-ok lines
